WITH rpt_deal_facts AS (
SELECT src.deal_id, src.organization_id, src.title, src.stage, src.amount, src.currency_code, src.weighted_amount, src.company_id, src.company_name, src.owner_user_id, src.owner_name, src.created_at, src.closed_at, src.close_ts, src.aging_days, src.total_activities, src.total_calls, src.total_meetings, src.total_emails, src.days_since_last_touch, src.quote_count, src.accepted_quote_total, src.avg_discount_pct FROM (
SELECT 
  d.id AS deal_id,
  d.organization_id,
  d.title,
  d.stage,
  COALESCE(d.amount, 0) AS amount,
  CASE
    WHEN pq.currency IS NOT NULL AND pq.currency <> 'USD' THEN pq.currency
    WHEN o.country IS NOT NULL AND o.country <> 'US' AND cc.curr IS NOT NULL THEN cc.curr
    WHEN pq.currency = 'USD' THEN 'USD'
    WHEN o.country = 'US' THEN 'USD'
    ELSE 'USD'
  END AS currency_code,
  ROUND(COALESCE(d.amount, 0) * (
    CASE d.stage
      WHEN 'qualification' THEN 0.10
      WHEN 'discover' THEN 0.25
      WHEN 'propose' THEN 0.50
      WHEN 'negotiate' THEN 0.75
      WHEN 'closed_won' THEN 1.00
      WHEN 'closed_lost' THEN 0.00
      ELSE 0.00
    END
  ), 2) AS weighted_amount,
  d.company_id,
  c.name AS company_name,
  d.owner_user_id,
  su.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(su.last_name, '') AS owner_name,
  d.created_at,
  d.closed_at,
  COALESCE(d.closed_at, d.created_at) AS close_ts,
  FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - d.created_at))/86400)::integer AS aging_days,
  COALESCE(act.total_activities, 0)::integer AS total_activities,
  COALESCE(act.total_calls, 0)::integer AS total_calls,
  COALESCE(act.total_meetings, 0)::integer AS total_meetings,
  COALESCE(act.total_emails, 0)::integer AS total_emails,
  act.days_since_last_touch::integer AS days_since_last_touch,
  COALESCE(q_agg.quote_count, 0)::integer AS quote_count,
  COALESCE(q_agg.accepted_quote_total, 0) AS accepted_quote_total,
  COALESCE(q_agg.avg_discount_pct, 0) AS avg_discount_pct
FROM crm.deals d
LEFT JOIN crm.companies c ON c.id = d.company_id AND c.organization_id = d.organization_id
LEFT JOIN accounts.setup_users su ON su.id = d.owner_user_id
LEFT JOIN accounts.organizations o ON o.id = d.organization_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT q.currency 
  FROM crm.quotes q 
  WHERE q.deal_id = d.id AND q.organization_id = d.organization_id 
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN q.status = 'accepted' THEN 1 WHEN q.status = 'sent' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, q.updated_at DESC 
  LIMIT 1
) pq ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT CASE o.country 
    WHEN 'India' THEN 'INR' 
    WHEN 'United Kingdom' THEN 'GBP' 
    WHEN 'Germany' THEN 'EUR' 
    WHEN 'Canada' THEN 'CAD' 
    WHEN 'Australia' THEN 'AUD' 
    ELSE 'USD' 
  END AS curr
) cc ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_activities,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE da.type = 'call') AS total_calls,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE da.type = 'meeting') AS total_meetings,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE da.type = 'email') AS total_emails,
    FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(da.created_at)))/86400) AS days_since_last_touch
  FROM crm.deal_activities da 
  WHERE da.deal_id = d.id AND da.organization_id = d.organization_id
) act ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS quote_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN q.status = 'accepted' THEN q.total ELSE 0 END) AS accepted_quote_total,
    AVG(q.discount_pct) AS avg_discount_pct
  FROM crm.quotes q 
  WHERE q.deal_id = d.id AND q.organization_id = d.organization_id
) q_agg ON TRUE
WHERE d.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
) src WHERE TRUE
)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(CAST(AVG(days_since_last_touch) AS DECIMAL), 1), 0.0) AS avg_days_since_last_touch FROM rpt_deal_facts AS deal_facts WHERE stage IN ('qualification', 'discover', 'propose', 'negotiate') AND days_since_last_touch IS NOT NULL AND TRUE AND TRUE AND TRUE LIMIT 500
